openQuestions: Official name in English and Ukrainian, canonical domain and postal address, from the official site and the EDEBO register.
Dated official statement for the current academic year on whether, where and how foreign students are taught.
State registration (EDEBO), programme licence (Ministry or EDEBO licence register) and NAQA accreditation for each health programme: three separate claims.
Which medicine, dentistry, pharmacy or nursing programmes admit foreign applicants, in which language, with what duration and intake, and the official fee page.

Relocation lead (unverified): No relocation reported. All leads keep the main campus at Фонтанська дорога 33, Odesa 65009 (osvita.ua, university journal PDFs, education.ua college listing). Signs of continued activity: 2025 non-budget Dentistry offers and a 2026 intake at the affiliated medical college (vstup.osvita.ua 2025; education.ua, 2026 dates); a 2024 news report (life.pravda.com.ua) that vice-rector Borys Vasyliev was killed in a missile attack on Odesa confirms the university existed and was staffed in 2024. An undated blog (plandiy.com.ua) claims 'вісім факультетів, два фахові коледжі та підрозділ у Чернівцях' (a unit in Chernivtsi) – unverified. No dated official 2025/26 statement on teaching location or format (in person / remote) was found. Odesa is subject to missile attacks; this is a wartime operating-risk note, not a fact about the institution.

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: Official domain unsettled: three conflicting candidates with no result from the institution's own main site — mgu.edu.ua (osvita.ua 'Веб-сайт: https://mgu.edu.ua' plus one other directory), mgu.com.ua (xuanxiao.org; this session's search summary also attributed it to the ProZ listing, whose snippet earlier showed no domain), mgu.od.ua (university law journal at vestnik-pravo.mgu.od.ua; college site epk-mgu.od.ua).

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: Name confusion: (a) informally presented as 'Міжнародний університет' (blog; college title on education.ua) with no formal renaming notice found; (b) a Russian-language college title introduces an 'Одеський медичний інститут' of IHU, unverified; (c) Odesa International Medical University (Одеський міжнародний медичний університет) is a DIFFERENT private institution (MON PDF 17.01.2020 and Wikipedia) and must not be merged; (d) the abbreviation 'МГУ' collides with Moscow State University in Russian usage.

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: Every foreign-applicant, English-medium and fee claim for Medicine, Dentistry and Pharmacy comes from agents (brive.com, rmcedu.com) or aggregators; figures conflict (€4,386.20 vs €4,380.52 per year; 'USD 33,600 total'; faculty counts '6 faculties with 46 departments' vs 'a few faculties, 2 institutes and 17 departments'); one directory earlier gave teaching languages 'Russian;English'. An aggregator itself cautions IHU 'is not widely listed among top Ukrainian medical universities, so recognition by national medical councils should be checked'.

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: No EDEBO licence evidence for specialty 222 Medicine, 221 Dentistry or 226 Pharmacy, no licence volume for foreign students, and no NAQA programme accreditation found; the 'IV accreditation level' wording is the legacy institutional level only.

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: The only 222 Medicine admission-data record shown carries 2021 data; a current (2025/26) Medicine offer for IHU was not shown, so admissions availability is unproven and possibly outdated.

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: Odesa is under wartime missile attack (a 2024 news report says the university's vice-rector was killed in a strike); no dated official statement on current teaching location/format was found.
